owner_fixed_rule: current_task_state == RUNNING && proposed_unrequested_task != current_task_id -> ASK_CURRENT_USER_BEFORE_TASK_SWITCH; accept -> explicit_task_transition_receipt; decline -> continue_current_task_or_wait
reason: request_id and free text are transport/message identities, not authority-grade task identity. Guessing task changes inside token ingress could either interrupt current work incorrectly or silently accept a real task switch without consent.

candidate_integration_direction.shape: Needle/intent layer emits provenance-bound typed ProposedTaskIdentity before V16 task-switch gate
candidate_integration_direction.same_task: continue active execution without new switch consent
candidate_integration_direction.different_unrequested_task: enter WAITING_USER / ASK_CURRENT_USER_BEFORE_TASK_SWITCH without releasing global execution ownership
candidate_integration_direction.accept: commit explicit task transition receipt, then update current_task_id/state
candidate_integration_direction.decline: preserve old current_task_id and continue or wait
candidate_integration_direction.authority: model/Needle classification is evidence only; deterministic V16 gate owns transition admission

required_discriminators: same semantic task with new request_id must not trigger switch prompt
different task from same authenticated session must prompt before transition
different task from another client while Frank is busy remains FRANK_BUSY and cannot steal task authority
ambiguous/open-set task identity must abstain to user clarification rather than transition
accept/decline receipts survive restart and preserve lease epoch provenance
stale accept receipt from an older task-transition generation cannot apply to a newer current task
